acceptance.given: Disposable packages containing otherwise equivalent complex deterministic check declarations vary only the invocation shell field: explicit boolean false, omitted, boolean true, and string "false". Expected values are frozen independently of candidate policy.

oracle.expected: During static validation, explicit boolean shell=false satisfies the shell-mode check. Omitted, true, and string-valued shell declarations produce structured failures identifying the declaration path and applicable shell-mode rule. No supplied command executes.
forbidden: Static validation accepts an omitted shell field or implicitly supplies false.
Static validation accepts shell=true or coerces the string "false" into boolean false.
The validator executes the declared command to determine its shell mode.
An unconditional pass implementation satisfies the assertions.
oracle.observable: The real validate_package entry returns declaration-specific status, rule, path and code for each shell-field variant; an execution-boundary observer detects any attempt to execute the supplied command during static validation.

acceptance.then: Only an explicitly declared boolean false satisfies the invocation shell-mode constraint; invalid variants fail static validation without executing the supplied command.
acceptance.when: The planned test_a11 parameter cases directly call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package and evaluate the invocation declaration during static validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a11 with explicit shell-field parameter identities and obligation-specific assertion bindings. Through the real validate_package entry, raise AssertionError if explicit boolean false is rejected by the shell check, an omitted/true/string shell field is accepted, or the supplied command executes. Run the targeted argv command with a 300-second harness timeout. Missing production imports, absent tests, environment errors and timeouts are blockers or harness failures, never causal RED.

affected_subjects: Complex deterministic check invocation shell declaration
